thread:
Rafi: Heads-up — launching the mini benchmark webinar next week. Need a quick social sprint: 1) LinkedIn carousel (3 cards), 2) X single-image + short caption, 3) 15s clip for stories. Also need lead routing so we capture registrants separately. Who can pick up assets? @Anika?

Anika: I can do the LinkedIn carousel. Can someone drop the distilled 3 takeaways and the preferred logo lockup? Prefer PNGs with transparent bg.

Blake: I have the takeaways. Dropping copy here: 
- 48% faster inference on common prompts
- 2.4x cost improvement with batching
- consistent 99.9% uptime under load
Will add methodology blurb. Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/mini-bench

Rafi: Nice. For routing: tag leads with `webinar-bench-apr` and route to `inbound-webinar` queue. @Priya can you add the rule and set auto-assignment to SDR rotation?

Priya: Yep. I'll add rule + UTM mapping. Which UTM do we want?

Rafi: Use utm_campaign=bench_apr26&utm_medium=social&utm_source=organic. Also set utm_content to `carousel` or `x_clip` depending on post.

Priya: Noted. I'll test mapping in test namespace and post results.

Anika: Carousel plan: Card1 hook + stat, Card2 methodology + visual, Card3 CTA + registration link. For CTA can we use short link? Want to track click-throughs.

Blake: Short link: rwd.io/bench-apr26 (works). Also recommend pin one stat as alt text for accessibility.

Rafi: Tone: audience is product managers and platform engineers. A/B test captions: (A) benefit-first, (B) technical-first. Keep X captions under 180 chars for better read.

Anika: I'll prepare both captions. Also export the carousel as PNGs + PDF for assets hub. ETA: Thu 4pm PT.

Ops-bot: Reminder: Peak engagement window suggested Mon/Tue 10:30 AM PT. Scheduling tool shows available slot Mon 10:30 PT.

Blake: I'll cut a 15s story clip from the 2:12 recording, emphasize "48% faster" at 0:04-0:06. Uploading raw now: https://drive.redwood.ai/raw/mini_bench/rec1.mov

Anika: For LinkedIn copy, do we want an extended quote from the PM who ran the test? It could add credibility.

Rafi: Yes — include a 1-sentence quote and name+role. Blake, can you get permission?

Blake: Reached out to PM, they approved short quote. Adding to Drive.

Priya: Test lead routing completed in staging at 11:12 PT — sample arrived in `inbound-webinar-staging` with tag `webinar-bench-apr` and utm params.

Anika: Draft captions (A/B) uploaded: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/copy/bench_apr_captions.md

Rafi: Great. Quick decision points before scheduling: 1) choose primary caption variant for initial publish (A or B), 2) confirm short link redirect and GA event, 3) finalize carousel images. Recommend start with benefit-first (A) and run technical-first as paid boost if we promote.

Priya: All tracking confirmed. GA event `webinar_click` will fire on short link redirect.

Anika: Carousel PNGs uploaded at 15:50 PT. Blake uploaded clip at 16:02 PT (15s).

Rafi: Let's schedule: Mon 10:30 PT — X clip + caption A; Tue 10:30 PT — LinkedIn carousel + long post; Wed 10:30 PT — X reminder w/ slide card. If first 24h CTR < 1.2% we flip CTA to "Watch on demand" and pin carousel.

Ops-bot: Scheduling job created: Wed slot reserved for reminder.

Rafi: Thanks team. Final ask: quick smoke test after scheduling to confirm utm and routing in prod. Priya, can you run that after publish?

Priya: Will run smoke test and report back.

Blake: One small creative note — can we add a subtle grid overlay to Card2 to show methodology? Uploaded alt version.

Anika: Nice idea. Using alt v2. Closing this thread once smoke test passes.

Priya: Smoke test passed post-publish at 10:36 PT — lead landed in `inbound-webinar` queue with correct tags.
